This is a **live demonstration** of the multi-page report produced by the
`nbis-folium` skill. It uses Roy Francis's
[folium](https://github.com/royfrancis/folium) Quarto template, with the
report section and completion page shown in the sidebar.

The navbar logo is deliberately left as the upstream static asset. This proves
that the multi-page template's standard asset pipeline works when published to
GitHub Pages. The inline-SVG logo workaround is needed only by the separate
[single-page demo](https://pyrevo.github.io/nbis-folium-skill/), whose logo is
created at runtime.

::: {.callout-tip}
